_meta.collection_method: User-pasted Squirt.org city-proximity search result exports. Entries extend beyond each city because results include wide search radii. Additional wide-region UK name-only bulk export imported separately, preserving 1680 source appearances.
_meta.import_notes: The pasted Link column is blank for every record; no detail URLs or confirmed Squirt listing IDs may be fabricated. Photo IDs are separate unconfirmed hints extracted from a subset of provided photo paths. Preserve dates verbatim. De-duplicate raw search appearances but not geographic subareas without review.
_meta.privacy_scope: Only publicly available place-level information; no profiles, usernames, private messages, real-time user positions, check-ins or other identifying user data.
_meta.publication_rule: Manual imports are unverified research leads, not approved site listings. Verify venue relevance, safe/legal access and current status prior to publication; do not edit production listings.json during research.
_meta.caution: Latest Reply is a forum timestamp or relative display, not proof of physical cruising activity. Many listings are located far from queried city. Commercial gay sex venues remain outside cruising-area proposal scope.
_meta.country_assignment_method: Only selected place-specific city hints were assigned. An Edinburgh search batch may still contain mislocated records; each requires review.
_meta.source_url_gaps: All 205 records lack detail URLs in supplied Link column. No URLs are invented and photo IDs are not treated as confirmed listing IDs.
